name: generator
description: Portable fuel generators: DEPLOY a unit, REFUEL it from a fuel can, CONNECT it to a building junction box, and run it to back-feed power during an outage. Control hub verb is `generator`/`gen`.

connect.note: KNOWN GAP: acts on a deployed generator_portable furniture; examine has no hardcoded branch and the unit carries no tag/interactions. Discovered via the deploy confirmation + the furniture.describe status line.

plug.note: KNOWN GAP: alias of connect; same deployed-furniture gate.

refuel.note: KNOWN GAP: refuels a deployed generator_portable unit; not surfaced on examine.

generator.note: KNOWN GAP: control hub (start/stop/pack/disconnect/status) for a deployed unit; state/subcommand verb, not examine-surfaced.

gen.note: KNOWN GAP: alias of the generator hub verb.
